text: I like the game. It reminds me of Farmville. I wouldn't mind the wait time if I could do something like build in the process. But I have building that'll never get built because I need to spend real money to buy enough fake money for the materials. I'm not gonna do that so basically my town won't grow or will take forever to grow in population. Other games seem to have figured out how to let people play without paying. I end up spending 5 mins in the game before nothing left to do.

The town building is good, but the matching games are absolutely terrible. It's gotten to the point where I don't even play them anymore. It's literally pay to win and it's very irritating. You have to use EVERY power up just to finish a single puzzle. 15 turns to finish a puzzle that has 2 sections, without power ups going in is pointless. Not even remotely worth your time.

this is a game that's not sure what it is. by that I mean it's 50% a town building game and it's very good at that, and it's 50% a match 3 game that is among the more challenging of that genre. the only knock against the building side is some of the crops, mainly rubber, have an absurdly long wait especially because it is needed in so many different things. the big problem with the match 3 side is the total stupidity of the damn helicopters! I thought a "boost" was help u win, yet they don't !

They just removed the feature to confirm spending cash within the game. The buttons to spend cash are placed so you accidentally press the button. Support refused to refund, and refuses to address the issue by putting cash spend confirmation back. Additionally, in match 3, it's getting more and more complex, to the point of not being fun, and many levels require you to spend cash to complete. Awards have gone sharply downhill. in game currency now worth 90x less with last update.

I've been playing this game for over a year and only recently started spending a little bit of real $$ to get cool skins and extra boosters. The recent "economy update" makes it impossible to play the match-3 game (a major tool for acquiring boosters and skins) without spending ridiculous amounts of real $$. You used to be able to play casually for free, but now it feels like a cash grab. you'll get more $$ from me if you didn't make it feel like a waste.

update 2026: no longer as fun. Been playing for 8 yrs! Used to be tons of DIFFERENT mini games (building leap, easter hedges, smoothie bar, bridge builder, and many, many more). they're all gone, just match 3 and the same adventure game over and over for years now. play with my 75 yr old mom and I don't think she likes it as much anymore either. PLEASE BRING BACK old games, these are boring, hate match 3! 2019: Love this game! I play every day all throughout the day.

Bait and switch is the best way to describe this game. I downloaded this because of the ad that shows people running around providing a service and collecting money. That game only pops up every once in a while, but I still played. This game is pure money grab every month their "improvements" are just ways to make you pay to play. I'm considering deleting the app. It's too stressful and time-consuming. Very addictive as well.

Incredibly boring and tedious, build it and wait clicker clone. If you enjoy that type of game, then guess what, this one is still a bad version of it. Not even an hour or two in and your waiting times are already in the hours, not to mention the absolute clutter and chaos of your town, shops and barn space after getting some levels under your belt. The board is such a hot mess, you can barely tell what is what. Best part of the game is the match-3 side mini game and it rarely ever crashed.

I downloaded the game for the minigame shown in the ad. This shows up 𝑣𝑒𝑟𝑦 𝑟𝑎𝑟𝑒𝑙𝑦, and I'm assuming each egg/crop is coded as its own separate entity, because it lagged so badly it was almost unplayable. Also, I'd only been playing for a few minutes before I had to wait 10+ minutes before I could do anything. Match three (once it's unlocked) is often the only thing to do, and since I really don't care for match three games, it was not enjoyable.

There's a noticeable difference in how difficult it is to obtain prizes from the adventure part of the game as well as land expansion materials. It shouldn't have to play ONE regular level 55 times to get past it. And those levels are often harder than those labeled "super hard". I get that you all want to make money but this is bs. If you don't pay, you can't progress through the game. Zero stars if I could.

If you want a fun town building game where you can decorate and manage a city, don't get this game. If you want a candy crush mini game, then congrats, this is the game for you. It used to be so fun, and now they're making it harder and harder. Tasks in the regatta are basically impossible at this point, and you barely get any rewards. The graphics look like a child's game now and they've gotten rid of everything fun.

The nice thing is that there are a variety of activities...something to appeal to everyone. The irritating thing is that they FORCE you to engage with the mini games every time a new one is added. Everything else freezes and you can do nothing until you've clicked through to the mini game, waited for it to load, waited for the intro, waited for it to exit and reload the original game. I personally use the app for one thing only, and I don't appreciate the manipulation.

It takes forever to get materials, figured I'd buy materials for a few buildings. Built some, played for a bit, saved and closed. Went back hours later, they were back to waiting to be built, but materials and money were still gone. Tried to chat about it, took over 4 hrs for response, so I didn't see til next day. They said it didn't update because app was open on 2 devices. I only have 1 device, never played this game before. They were zero help and did nothing to fix the issue. I uninstalled

Okay so let's state the obvious 1. The ads obviously show a different game and that is why I downloaded this. it's a town building game not the farming game. 2. I'm playing this at a snail pace because there are 2 hour wait times. Throw in a 'watch an ad' option at least. Oh I need 4 bricks to finish building a post office, but my train takes 2 hours to return and really I'm stuck because I need more population. You have to pay if you want to actually enjoy this game.

The level of detail that's put into much of the game is really impressive. I gave it one star now due to the difficulty in obtaining "building supplies"to complete buildings. They take up too much barn space! In addition to that you can't contact a human and now they've almost doubled the cost of the Golden ticket and removed the airport icon so you have to go find the airport in your town to send planes. My barn is full when the ticket expires thanks to building supplies I can't use!

I appreciate the different story-based games to continue to try to get coins and points to further build while waiting for supplies, land expansion, etc. but after having this game downloaded for two weeks, I've uninstalled it. I hit level 50 in the color match and couldn't proceed without boosters. I cannot justify continuing to dump money into the game just to finish builds or speed up supply runs, much less pass mini games. total money grab in my opinion. shame.

This game used to be a lot of fun a few months ago. The town aspect and the players helping each other aspect were both a lot of fun, but lately the developers have been really pushing a mini game that's a lot like candy crush. They are making it basically impossible to earn rewards anymore from just playing in the town, you have to play the mini game to earn anything worthwhile. That's just not what I signed up for. hope they fix this one day, but I'm uninstalling

This used to be a great game. I've played for almost 10 years,and they have completely ruined it. It is basically another match 3, prizes and most of the tasks are linked to it instead of focusing on the original game. I got this game because it was not a match 3. There used to be fun side games and a variety of different ones, now it's only match 3 which are frustrating, boring, and repetitive. They refuse to listen to their players, my co-op is wanting to quit because of how bad it is now.

This game is just straight up weird.. first of all, it's not as advertised from what I've seen. The stuff they show in the ads is HARDLY a part of it. It might be petty, but that's already 1 star territory for me. Then, there are 3 aspects to the main game and none of them are done particularly well. The whole thing is heavily punctuated, play, wait, repeat, not my favorite. The matching part is stupidly hard sometimes too, so there is often times literally nothing to do. Waste of phone storage

Really getting so tired of this game. Spent thousands over the 3 years I've been playing it because you CAN'T keep playing without spending and advance. Took 3 months away from it after support was an absolute joke about me getting zero rewards for spending $100 in a mini game. Same mini game popped up just now and it wanted me to pay SEVENTEEN levels in it. Time to delete again.

I like the little details in this game that if you aren't looking closely you might miss. For example all the little interactions between the NPC's or the shadows of the stingrays and dolphins in the ocean just to sight a couple. As a console/hand-held gamer I really appreciated the little dude that was out in the middle of nowhere by himself rock climbing at the edge of the map when I went looking around. The regular game play is fine but it's highly geared toward in-ap purchase. -0.05

please remove the batteries from the match games! they give you something like 15 moves to get like 20 batteries, and there's bricks surrounding them! Some levels are so hard I spend days and days trying to pass and can usually only do so by buying more moves, which took me days to collect the cash. I really liked this game but some of the super hard levels are just too hard. it makes it so its not fun anymore.

I play on both the mobile (Pixel) and PC platforms and the only big negative, I have for the game are the updates. on PC, I have only had a couple of hang-ups not getting the update, but on mobile, I have a terrible time. for the last update both updated with no issues, but on this current and for others in the past, I could be waiting forever. It takes a super long time for an update to be available in the Goggle Play Store, while the PC is doing okay with updates. This is getting tiresome.

Ruined Township. Now you do very little in your town because they try to shuttle you to terrible Match 3 games to earn "energy" to then explore a map. In order to move 2 obstacles, you may have to play the Match 3 10-15 times. They also changed the Tcash rates and it is outrageously more expensive. Save your time, save your money. They are probably easier and more fun Match 3 where the goal probably isnt to rob you. They have clearly shown their long term players don't mean a thing. in

Not a terrible game overall. The farming does take a while and requests from the helicopter become a bit overwhelming at a point. The absolute WORST part of this game is that damn AI that controls where the match-3 helicopter powerups go. Alone or mixed, it always goes for the worst possible spot to hit the least important blocks it possibly can.

the match 3 game becomes impossible around level 60-ish, then to get anywhere you have to make things and deliver the things you make. problem with this, is at higher levels, time to make takes 4 or 5 hours. you can buy, with real money game money to speed things up, but I dislike greedy games like this. the cost quickly exceeds the rewards and dissatisfaction replaces pleasure of the game. im clearing and deleting... time to move on

Its not what I expected but I am enjoying it. I appreciate it doesnt push spending money in game but its option. I feel the in game purchases are a little overpriced, so I am not able to say if its worth it or if it progresses your gameplay any. There is a chat feature for your team, I dont think thats necessary but I do like that we can help each other out. overall, there is plenty to do to keep you entertained!

I have played this game for several years. I use to love playing it! Now I think this game just makes people mad. You get stuck on the mini game for days, and I mean days before you can pass hard/ super hard levels. The game is not fun anymore. And if you don't spend money on the game it's even worse. Do better township!!

Can no longer recommend this game. the town cash system is now ridiculous as is cost of the adventure item removal. In addition there must be a improvement in the match three puzzles, there has to be a way to cancel the puzzle. if you can't win after 3 tries then you should have the option to move to the next.

The game is really fun in all, but whenever I'm working on my town, it gets interrupted with a side quest. It gets really annoying. Also, for that one part of the game that's always shown in the ads isn't there. I was hoping to play that side quest game while I wait for the timer to run out on the township. Instead, I get stuck with a stupid matching game that reminds me of Toon Blast. It's really annoying, too. I feel like everything in it is just a huge scam. I'm probably going to delete it.

Very addictive game. It takes a lot of strategy and planning to build the town, make product, and advance. It does take a little $ to be able to move up, and it helps to be on a team and give to each other. The most annoying thing is that the barn is always full, so you have to log in every so often to get what you need and spend money to get anywhere. It's a challenging game. The match 2 or 3 levels are super hard and can be frustrating but that's where you get play $ to spend.

A good game overall. Been playing for years. But, nothing changes with updates, it's not offline, and the adventure part is gone. did you all make the money enough to shitcan the game? kinda like Wizard101. Why do you update? the only change is you killed the side quest adventure game. I have played the match 3 until it's so hard I can't come close to advance at all. now again I have to update. I run at 128k, and with Google Play it takes 3 hours, if it doesn't time out after 60 percent. unhappy

Hello! The town building portion of the game is decent, but the levels are such a money grab. For example, level 72. It's not marked as hard or anything, just a regular level. 11 moves to clear boxes and drop down 3 keys as well as borders. I spent 45 minutes on it (infinite hearts) trying to clear it. You kinda just have to sit there playing over and over trying to get a good set up on most levels past 50 ish, or you have to spend money on it to win. Absurd. If you want money, not the way to go

Bait & switch!! This game has devolved into a match three game. Everything now revolves around playing match 3. There is town building and farming but the amount of materials needed to do anything has become absurd. You can no longer finish tasks and challenges unless you mainly play the ridiculous match 3. They used to have fun side games, but that ended.

I've seen that once you get moved out of the top three the points for tasks goes down. Also there have been a loss of items to get the the items needed to complete the barn to be able to have more access. It used to take two weeks to complete a upgrade to the barn. I'm also seeing a decline in the extras for the games, we only get two dollars for each item left. I have not been able to get over 60 dollars or above 170 dollar points.

I have left my initial review as 5 stars until now. I give it a 3 star because: 1. They removed the zoo; 2. they increased cash but it doesn't help because it is based on inflation existing; 3. you can't decorate like you could in the past; 4. the levels make you use everything just to pass concerning the puzzle play; 5. there really isn't much support if something goes wrong.

Love this game!!!! Except the part about accidentally hitting the speed up button on crops or whatever and WASTING the cash that is SO DIFFICULT to collect!!!! The other drawback is getting the pieces you need in order to complete community buildings. I'm stuck, can't grow my town because the trains don't bring the right building materials.

Been stuck on the same match 3 level for 4 weeks now. But, for $4.99 I can buy the needed boosters and moves to help me advance 1 level. No thanks. That should tell you all you need to know about this game. you either build your town, or solve puzzles, but don't expect to do both without real $. this isn't a puzzle game, it's a fraud game.

game is addicting at first but when you get to the higher levels it takes hours for things you need to make also . complaint to the game is that you can accidently spend so much of your ( game ) money without confirmation and its just gone. and some times the app glitches after you complete a task and you dont get the credit. anyways hope they fix those things besides that. pretty chill and goes slow if you dont spend real money

I liked it fine until I got to about Level 30. Now it takes sooo long to do anything that it's not fun anymore. UPDATE: Been playing for seven years, off and on. It's a good way to kill time. what bothers me. though, is that the game play in their ads is NOT anything at all like the real game play. That's quite deceptive!! You don't have to lie and mislead in order to get people to play. Do better!!

It starts off good. No ads, which means the user is the product. It quickly builds and is not quite 'enough' without some purchases. Bonuses and 'cheats' are essential to progress. The 'candy crush' element of the game is what ruins it. The levels soon reach a degree of difficulty where you just turn off for failing all the time. More cheats need to be purchased. Then you use them all but still spend half a day on a level which is practically unbeatable, it all becomes pointless. Uninstalling.

This was my favorite game. What's changed is they have become primarily a match 3 game.The team activity is a regatta, and to advance, the match 3 is the primary way to get there. Other activities are scattered throughout the menu board, but the match 3 is prevalent. It has become difficult to pass levels without spending cash to buy Township dollars. I would need to spend $15-20 a week to pass 2-3 levels. I spend $5 weekly, and I wish it went farther. I had a full team, now only 2 are active.

I used to enjoy passing my time with this game. However they seem to update it every five minutes. Every update makes it worse & worse. The advertisements that I see for this game are absolutely NOTHING like the game that I have been playing. When you spend money in the game, they set you up to continue to spend money in the game if that makes sense. It's hard to advance without spending money. I see it for what it is & choose to no longer engage.

Probably going to delete AGAIN. It's a fun game for several levels but I'm on level 34 now and the game has come to a screeching halt even after a purchase! The developers make the puzzles unwinnable after a certain point. I played some puzzles 20 times or more just to try to move on and wound up giving up other options in the game in order to be able to push past the BORING, DRONING NIGHTMARE of a puzzle game. 🤦‍♀️

This game does not have a button to confirm in-game purchases. while playing the gem game, I swiped to the left at the same time the pop-up asking me to spend cash to continue. I did not want to spend $900 for a few moves. It takes a while to earn the cash and I would have rather restarted the level. Because I was in the middle of a move when it happened I swiped to the left and ended up clicking the button. The game took the money. AI Support is NO HELP. This game is terrible. Zero stars 🦨💨

This game has gone downhill. The regatta is no longer segregated by the number of participants. I am a co-op of 1 and have to constantly compete against co-ops of 5 active racers. The mini game is always the same type and you no longer earn regatta points the same way, either. So disappointed. Also, the ad that pops up for Township under other games is a flat out lie! None of the game play in the ad is possible.

*editing to add a few suggestions. -you should allow partial fills on train and plane assistance. -you should be able to cancel making an item and just lose the ingredients used to make that item. Not what the ad advertised. Game takes FOREVER to make/grow items. You literally get to play for maybe 2 minutes, then wait 2 hours for stuff you really need to refresh. It's very frustrating.

I wanted a game that i could spend as little or as much time playing as I could fit in. the match 3 portion of this game is atrocious. absolutely impossible levels without using boosts , and even then your chances are slim to none. the "crafting" is asinine, takes you 4 hours to grow 1 tree to be used in a fudge pop that also takes hours to craft. I spent a few dollars on the pass and regret it. game is clearly a cash grab.

Very addictive game. I've been playing this game for over a year. They have raised the price on items. Meaning in the game for a bomb on the mini games cost a fortune. Also the hammer, axes, saws and paint , they all take to long to receive. Please give us more throughout the game! So we can expand at a little more quicker. Oh, and the barn! You do not give us enough room at times to store items! I'm just going in circles selling items. It's literally my Birthday! Call it my birthday wish🤞🎂

I used to play this game a lot and really enjoyed it. I didn't play for a while and missed playing so I decided to re-download the game. That was a huge mistake! the new upgrades are horrible! They have made it so hard to pass a level. before you could sit and play for a couple hours now in 10 you have gone thru all your lives just trying to pass one level, but didnt....I am deleting it again. so sad it's a money grab now...ps also nothing like the ads you see for the game. good luck

game is fun, although the ad that I saw for it are only mini games, which is not what I initially signed up for. the community is great if you have a good team! pretty frequently there is a bug where the game freezes when you're in the chat and you have to close the app and open it back up again, which is super frustrating. I wish it was easier to gain the ingots for upgrading buildings, trains, and ships.

I downloaded this app based on an ad and the game is nothing like the ad. not only that, it's an obvious money grab game. I only get about 5 minute of game play before there's nothing else to do but wait. Most things take a long while to build, grow etc unless you want to spend real money, which is still costly. The dollars arent easy to come by without purchase but easy to spend; they removed the confirmation button so its easy to accidentally spend your hard earned money

It was great till it wasn't. The barn gets full quick. I upgraded it several times even when I paid for a pass from the materials that were delivered by the trains. The pass ended & my barn capacity dropped to 285 from 370. I worked hard by filling orders to increase the barn space! Reaching customer service is like pulling teeth with a string. The bot takes you in circles & you can't reach an agent. It's very frustrating. Time to look for a new game.

Used to play this game like it was going out of style. One of the games that had the misleading ads, but despite that it was still fun. I took a break for a while and came back and they have completely rehauled the cash system in the game. You basically have to spend money now in order to keep playing. And now they have creepy AI ads they are pushing in addition to totally false gameplay ads. I'm not only stopping playing but I'm uninstalling. Don't download this game.

I've been playing this game since covid and have made a lot of friends all over the world. However, the game is no longer as fun as it used to be. Bring back animated stickers!!The match 3 levels are getting harder and you're forced to spend TS money to finish some levels. 900 TS$!!! The amount you win in the game and in the mine does not add up near enough to even be worth it! Bring back the random games set up near the train depot. Go back to the way it used to be! It was more fun then!!!

It's a shell of its former self. So much focus on the expeditions - which aren't interesting nor have anything to do with the town building portion of the game. The match-3 is difficult and and unrewarding. The town building is an afterthought and hard to progress in. I miss the game from 2-3 years ago - especially all the mini games they used to run and the decorations that used to be handed out as prizes. Oh, and the Towncards are just another thing taken from other games.

I used to spend a ton of time on this game. After reinstalling it, I've noticed it's gone downhill. The in-game properties now cost millions, which seems impossible to get with how coins are distributed. Plus, having to pay 3900 in-game currency to keep playing after a loss feels like too much. So, I'm just going to uninstall it and stop playing. My old team, who used to play a lot, has also stopped playing so that let me know this game has really went downhill.

Do yourself a favor and do NOT begin this game. The levels are very frustrating, every 3rd level is a hard level, and you will have to spend money unless you want to be stuck on levels for days and not be able to compete in side competitions. There are some fun elements but it's not worth the frustration. Save yourself the unnecessary stress.

Updating my review from 5 stars to 1 star as recently there are less options to build per level, the goods/trains/planes take longer than they used to & cost more to make/plant/send, and the match three games are not skill based. I like that they made it so you can win $ to play in the town but then you can't win the games so it's pointless and it's so expensive to carry on the game to get to the next level. To the game developers: Please do better for those of us that are fans...

The game is sadly just another pay to win game. From some of the reviews I am reading, others are also having issue with accidentally clicking on the "pay with towncash to speed x up." It is so frustrating because I don't want to use it but these buttons pop up and then you waste the money on it. The other part of the game requires so many power ups to beat them and urges you to spend money to get extra moves and such to win. It would be a good game if the developers weren't so money hungry.

This game is nothing like it was advertised. It is basically guided gameplay where you have to build what it says, do exactly what it says, like... no thanks. Very disappointing, dull, and boring. I am so tired of a game being advertised a LOT differently then what it actually is. Uninstalled after 45 min when I realized I was not going to be able to play the advertised game.

I've played Township for years, but sadly I'm done. The variety of mini-games used to make the game fun, but now everything revolves around matching games and events that push the same gameplay. I was close to winning a boat event grand prize, yet every spin landed on the lowest reward, which felt rigged. To top it off, the ads show a game that's nothing like the real one. I wish the advertised version actually existed. It's disappointing to see a game I enjoyed for years move in this direction

This game is an addictive ripoff. I played for 8 years and reached a very high level, during which time it transformed from fun to frustrating. You can't progress without spending money! All my teammates agreed but were addicted and found it hard to quit. I was finally banned from the game and they would not tell me why, even after repeated requests. Customer Service offers only automated responses and are unresponsive to concerns. Search the net on Township banning before downloading.

completely a trick and scam game, not the same as the ads, only once you reach certain levels. This game can't run a farm properly. Everything takes a ridiculous amount of time, and filling requests nearly impossible as the requests come in as fast you fill them. But what makes me hate games like this is that it deliberately tries to have you spend money in order to completely things faster and to buy moves for puzzles. miss good days when games were just for fun.

Would give negative stars if I could. Could be a good game if it wasn't for that stupid match game. Play levels 20 or more times just to get through them. Actual game play, after a certain level, is one of those wait for hours, sometimes over a day, for an action to finish. Designed for pay to play. In one review, they replied "Thanks for your thoughts", those aren't thoughts, they are facts.

I am addicted to this fricken game😂 it doesn't get old, constantly new things to do, new prizes to go for, new adventures to be had, NO ads, can play offline... I took off one star for the clickbate ads that got me to get it in the first place! NOT as advertised AT ALL and definitely NOT what I wanted... but I don't regret sticking with it at all😜👍

I played this game for a long time and enjoyed it, even making occasional cash purchases to help progress in the game. However, in the last updates, they have changed the game so that it is nearly impossible to finish the side challenges in the game that are dependent on completing levels on a match three mini-game which has become so difficult that you have to spend real money to complete a level.

I been playing this game for maybe 5 years now. I like the variety of ways to play, no rush on farming and what not. the new match games to get points, cash etc are stressful and pointless. the only monthly inner game has been the same for years now, using energy to move items to find items in a jungle, beach etc. no changes. I can't keep updating to do the same thing. I like my team I was on and it was good and I would still play but I remove apps to keep the game but I'll recommend the game

Everything was going good then they changed the value of the "township" green cash with NO explanation. Just last night I bought a simple item and didn't even receive it. Was a cool game but not now. Plus good luck reaching someone...but you can always spend money 💰 though!!! Edit-Now they're saying I actually received it and I didn't. Well it's ok. Hopefully enough people complain so something can be done!

I enjoy the game but if there is one thing I think needs to be fixed ASAP is that you add a confirmation button in case you ACCIDENTALLY click to pay 900 to add more moves in the game. it's an absurd amount to begin with and to accidentally click it because you ALREADY MAKE PEOPLE PAY $3 TO GET YOUR OWN MONEY IS ABSURD. actually take that off too!next time this happens to me I'm quitting the game all together. won't even matter how much I've invested in it. it's a waste of money in the end!!!!!

It used to be fun, but, this recent update where it cost $900 t-cash to continue a match play, now the 2x rewards is no longer on a timer, but you get "x" amount of tries which is far less than 30mins. The treasure game eats up 50pts every time you clear a path, so you burn thru points extremely faster, forcing you to play more, longer, and then have to buy more. Next, even the match play games you can't win half of them anymore without buying stuff. No more spending like crazy 4 me folks🤷🏾

it's fun until it's not. I thought you were going to be able to navigate your character between harvesting and sales and collecting money and then collecting your crops to earn money but then that ends really quick and then you're back into a town building game which is fun for a while until it's not fun anymore and you don't have enough money to construct anything and then there's literally nothing to do unless you want to spend money and I don't. graphics are good. no glitches.

I absolutely LOVE this game! There's just one tiny issue... If the devs could make a way we could see our town from a further perspective, that would be amazing! Right now you can only zoom out so far and it barely captures how vast your town is. PLEASE devs! Put this in an update! Also for those who are complaining about the mini-games: you don't HAVE to play them. But it does help you earn cash/coins to progress your town. The 3-match game can be difficult but you can earn power-ups in-game.

I started this game along time ago and really enjoyed it. It was fun and not to difficult to pass levels. I actually started with this game before it had the mini game. I say this because it was perfect for those who wants to play for more than 20 minutes. Now I can't afford to. The mini game is impossible if you don't have boosters or $. Unfortunately this game shows it sold out!!! Don't enjoy it anymore. Went from $ to $$$$ simply to expensive for what you get.

Honest review: If you're here after watching the ads, you'd be disappointed because it's not like that at all. This is just a typical base-building app disguised in farmville-esque aesthetics. I've only played a mini game similar to the ads ONCE IN TUTORIAL but never again. So that's an automatic minus for me. Because that doesn't sound honest ad for a game. I'm typically someone who wouldn't mind paying a few dollars if I'm happy with the game but this game is frustratingly slow to force you.

Puzzles eventually become impossible, pressuring you to pay a premium to finish them. I get developers need to make money, but this isn't a fun or fair mechanic. Especially when they game regularly makes you compete against other players for in-game prizes and progress. That's not fun when pay-to-win is a core mechanic of the game that the other players may be regularly using.

They make it too hard to progress without spending actual dollars. To progress in the treasure map part of the game is also too hard, costing 50 energy plus to remove an object so remove two and you're out of energy. There's also too much going on, too many 'attractions' to build and not enough space.

Filled with too many mini games (candy crush style) and ultimately trying to do too much. Don't get sucked in with the ads for the tractor or corn collecting, you get to play that once or twice and then almost never see it again. Could be a much better game simplifying it to a little township that you can expand but ultimately winds up trying to do everything and goes down too many different avenues to suck your time and money.

I was about to download the game to check if like the others, it is false advertisement, but, while reading the reviews I've decided to skip that part and cancel the installment. I believe if these developers have the knowledge to create the environment they advertise as a game, they should since puzzles is much more interesting then "building your own town." I have animal crossing for that.

nice game but it is taking very long time to develop the city. The museum seems useless since you will never get the township money even after collecting piece after piece. And the zoo has no chance to get developed as well since the last update (very disappointing, it was easier before). You struggle to collect animal cards and they are never enough to get a new animal. You basically struggle a lot in this game and it doesnt feel like making progresses

Very slow progress. Waiting time is too high to build. Keep you away from the game. Waiting time should be not more than 30 min for any items. Cash and Coins should have been bit easy to get so we can keep playing game for long time. Graphics are really good. But map and buildings placement needs to be 360° movement. Hopefully improvement is in next update.

The game keeps getting more and more repetitive. There used to be lots of fun mini-games, now they left only the most boring one, the candy-crush. There used to be lots of events. A few month ago it was down to 2, mine and transport magnate. Now it is just the mine. The 'adventures' are all the same. It was ok once or twice, but enough is enough, time for something new. Please bring back diversity in the game, all the various mini-games, events, competitions... Repetition brings boredom.

This game used to be fun, but now it's boring and repetitive. Expanding the main game takes too long to gather the necessary resources. The side quests WERE good, but now you need to spend real money to complete them because the allotted time is too short, and every 2nd or 3rd match-3 level is hard or very hard. The merge mini-games are a pain in the arse to play; they're frustrating because it's all pseudo-random luck to get the needed items to advance rather than skill. Don't waste your money!

Used to like the game, stopped playing a long time ago, mostly due to the false advertising of the game, claiming to be one type of game, then ending up to be something else. It's false advertising! You have done the same with fishdom, gardenscapes and homescapes. It boggles my mind that you're advertising it this way, when they are perfectly good games, why advertise them as a different game than what it actually is? Maybe when you start advertising the game, as the actual game, I'll play again

This game is okay and it is quite addictive but i have some issues with it, issue one: it won't let me use my own profile picture (which is a picture of myself) on the game when i log in to facebook, issue two: what is the aim of this game because all i am doing is putting buildings down in different places unloading or loading up and train and running out of space and issue three: it kind of gets boring after a while.

I have installed this game a few days ago and it is quite addictive. The only thing I'm finding is things take too long to build. Also, it's very difficult to upgrade community buildings or even something simple like the barn. The game is quite pleasant to the eye but I'm getting the impression that if you don't spend real money to buy their currencies you soon will be frustrated. It requires so many orders shipped and trains sent with cargo, it's annoying!

It's type of enjoyable game, but the other game that is like "candy crush" is so frustrating, the way you need to solve a one round in 10 moves, I'm in level 512 and you only have 22 moves, you need to remove the 64 snow and 19 fruits, but the fruit cannot be remove if you target it in one time, you need to double target the some of it, and it's kinda frustrating for me. I found it hard. I think they will give you a level that are impossible to solve for us to buy a money and use it solve a lvl.

I've been playing it for nearly 7 yrs now. Used to be my favorite, with various mini-games (not all great but you could always look forward to the good ones in the future). Now it is all about leading players to spend money! The only mini-games are related to the map adventures (so boring), the new regatta ìs stupid... I've devoted a lot of time and money to this game and that is the only reason I don't give up on it. So sad! Gave one star because I can't give ZERO.

As seems to be the case these days, the game is nothing like the ad. No, the devs have not made a 3rd person isometric farming sim, they've made a glacially paced city building game, and then marketed it as both the above and some sort of idle business tycoon game because those seem popular at the moment. And whilst there are no ads, unless you can spend 10 mins every hour or so throughout the day, to make any meaningful progress, you're going to have to buy in game currency constantly.

If you're a maths genius, then this game is fine. I find it incredibly difficult to figure out what I need to farm in order to meet all the orders; standard orders, train orders, helicopter orders, zoo orders... no doubt more that I've not reached yet. My favourite thing in the game was helping my friends, but for some reason yesterday they made it really difficult to find what your friends need help with. Please can that be changed back?

I enjoyed playing for a while, but it quickly became obvious that I was never going to be able to get the required building materials without paying too much money for them After about a week, I had 7 buildings I couldn't construct and all my quests depending on them, so after yet another useless train delivery I did the only rational action ... Uninstall It's fine for you if you're really rich, but if that's the case you've probably got better ways to spend your time! LOL

First of all, it's not like in the ads. Second, while yes, there are no ads in the gameplay, the way the game is designed is to really push you to use real money to keep the game engaging. For now I'm enjoying the game, but I just know this will end soon. Perhaps the developers can add a "watch ads for rewards" system, where you can CHOOSE to watch an ad to get a reward, instead of using real money.

The game is a good game, I really do like it. However, you spend more money on in game purchases than you actually get back from this game. I believe you can also implement some towncash rewards when you win a level in the side game attached to it. This way we will feel more motivated to play the side game Hope my suggestion can be taken into consideration. Also, the construction items like the tools are too hard to get that it takes a while before you can complete a Community building etc.

I like it, but I do agree with some other comments, it takes an age to build community buildings to increase town population, don't get me started on the zoo. Some enclosures require over 100 materials and that takes up space in your barn. I think they're being a bit unrealistic. Also the trains never bring you the items you need only what you've most of in the barn. I have played this game for 2 years and I'm only on level 66, that said, I do like it.

Update 2025-04-03. There was just another update and its gotten even worse. Playrix just wants money from you. If you want a game you can't progress in without spending lots of money, this is it!! Been playing for over 4 years. It's become a money grab and all based on a block game...all the variety and fun has left. Now it seems playrix is only interested in getting your money instead of supplying fun.

Update: uninstalled the game now. Absolutely not worth your time, it was fun for a bit and I didn't mind spending money even but not anymore. First of all, the game is nothing like the ad. Secondly, impossible to develop your town after certain level without spending money because the the trains keep bringing stuff you don't need to force you to spend money. As I've not been able to expand the town for at least 3 levels to build new factories etc I eventually lost interest.

I love town building games and games that you can maintain / play over a long period of time. Everything about this game is great expect for how hard it is to get bucks. The game really wants you to buy them in order to get certain things done. I wish it was eaiser to come across them or basic tasks did not cost so much to use them. Other than that it is a cute little time waster which is exactly what I'm looking for.

I downloaded it for the game I saw on the ad, and the real game isn't like that at all. this game is all about waiting to make progress and having the right supplies. Even at very early stages, the game is hella impossible to make progress in (as a way to force you to spend real money to progress faster, I suppose). I can't even begin to imagine it at higher levels... uninstalled.

How deadly-dull and what a rip-off! So I played a trial of the game, it was good so I went ahead and downloaded the game to play. Sadly when I came to play after download then I was met with some rather dull, 'plant some wheat.' I don't think so! Slow, patronising, so you guessed it, I un-installed the game! I'm not into long, painfully slow task completions! Great if you 6 year's of age.... Soz guys too much.

Great game for creativity and interaction with other players. I really love it but I walked away because huge demands for minor products meant I was going to have to dump many more valuable items that I spent more time and sometimes real money to acquire. (because all items must go thru the limited space given to you in your 'barn' (storage). I learned that sending unfilled planes caused a cascade of problems for building progress.)

Editing from 5 to 1. Overall been playing for 8 years. All was good up until the introduction of the golden pass. Free to play skins were quickly removed, decorations for events were removed and the game has become dull. The devs are leeching the in game currency (T-cash) with the only 3 remaining mini games that are made for you to play up to 40-50% completion, then become drastically hard in order to spend. Oh and dont bother with support, they never reply either on any of the above points.

They've sucked all the fun out of this game. No more variety of mini-games: it's all-match-3, all-the-time now. No more decorations to buy with regatta points. No more small special decorations AT ALL, just a gigantic 3x4 that can be won by playing enough Match-3. (So if you don't like Match-3 A LOT, skip this as they've gutted the town for it.)

Agree entirely with David Davies re mini games. Far too often "candy crush" type game. I don't want /expect easy but expanding isn't quick enough relative to buildings + unable to zoom out is why 95% of players don't lay out and just group buildings. (This is what stifled my creativity until viewing the area by "the orders" a little helpful). Although I've lowered my rating I'm still playing regularly.

Great graphics,but a big disaster with the piggy bank account. your hard earned money goes to piggy bank and then you have to buy it to use it, else you lose the 75 earned cash. i bought it once,but it appears again. are the game developers expecting that we keep buying it again and again. if there has to be a purchase it should be from the store option provided in the game. Really disappointed. Appreciate if you fix this.

I really like this game, an actual freemium game. You don't have to spend any money if you don't want to. In fact I think it's a bit unfair balanced if I look at what I can achieve within an hour bars work v.s. spending €5. The amount of coins you receive for paid content should be more. Update: I bought one coin pack and I seem to get a lot less free coins now from watching advertisements etc. like they expect me to pay for everything from now on, no more free stuff.

Had to edit my review. After a while, it becomes pretty evident that this game is completely rigged. No skill can get past the impossible match 3 levels that it throws at you over and over and over again. If you're looking for a game to throw money at, this game will suck it straight out of you. Luckily I only spent some saved up playstore credits. the difference in progression when paying compared to not paying is insane. AVOID.

Fun game overall but they are making me too many things very difficult to achieve, either you have to wait a lot, either spend money. You get too much of some construction materials and a few others extremely rare. The puzzle game is simply crazy, some levels impossible to reach, you have to wait or try until exhausted. Support = useless. That's why I took two stars off.

On level 379 of the puzzle. Ive been trying to beat this level for over 12 hours now. The algorithm of the AI controlling the game prevents you from getting the 5 in a row. It automatically changes it to a lesser number so you have no choice but to purchase dollars and you can see it in real time. You're not playing a real game you're playing a bot. Disappointing

The game has a lot of glitches. It takes forever for things to finish being made. When I make things and I am waiting for them to get to 1 min so I can pay the $1. And be done with it. Just this kerning I was waiting for the cooking to finish, it was at 2 min I left came back and it had changed from 2min to 17min but I could speed it up for $3. It has been like this forever!!! I enjoy certain parts of thos game like the regatta and building my town. BUT I HATE THESE GLITCHES ALL THE TIME MESS

False Advertisement. It's a Farmville knock off, not a game where you match the tools to the job. I didn't even see that once and I got to roughly level 18 before getting really bored and uninatalling the game. If you're looking for a farming style game to kill time (personally those games bore me), it's not that bad but if you actually wanted to play the matching game then don't bother with it!

When I first started playing over five years ago, I gave a Four Star rating (would have been 5 but the were quite a few glitches at the time). It was fun to play with a variety of in-games. In the past year, the game we knew and loved has changed. The Room Renovations and Zoo, which many of us worked hard and spent cash to complete, swept away. Those behind the game are only interested in extracting as much cash from players as possible, and it is boring and no longer fun to play :(

Another pay-to-play game.... yep sure you can get along without spending money but it is soooooo slow..... I have waited for 4 days for materials to arrive to complete a building.... but I can of course buy the money to complete it straight away in the Play store..... also with some quests (e.g. Airport) you have to produce the goods before the plane leaves.... of course often the only way to get goods fast enough is to spend more cash!

It's becoming very obvious that the game developer/management don't care about this game anymore. We still have Christmas theme decorations all over the town (it's mid Feb now). The mini Games are also becoming overly challenging in the way that you basically won't pass unless you pay heaps of real cash. So no, this game is not for me anymore after some years of playing.

I like the game and find the regatta and team feed helpful... but a few suggestions... as someone has mentioned, it takes too long to expand your ground or population. Maybe make train trips shorter. Also, some of the mini games are too hard. The explosive puzzle game use to be fun but is way too hard now and up too often. This puts me off opening any chests and is annoying when all gifts and prizes are related to that game.

I love the game but hate how slow the expansions are! Just this morning I noticed an error, I won 2 saws from chests in the mine and thought ''great just what I need for an expansion'', only to find the 2 saws have not even been added, I still only have one which was there before! What a rip off! The game is mean with cash pay outs so that you have to purchase packages with your debit card also it's impossible to fill plane orders unless you purchase the market help!

This game is really good fun but there is one aspect that just completely ruins the experience for me. It is too difficult to get building materials. I have three(!) community buildings that are ready except for the building materials and soon the fourth will join them. I have never sold any of the building materials, I am always hoarding them. I sent out one train after the other. And yet I can never get what I need. Unbalanced and very annoying!

The game is nothing like ads, and you have to have friends playing to get ahead, or pay to win. Everything is on timers so if you really want to play, you have to take breaks and come back as it deems, there is not enough access to construction resources to build up your town quickly, and you need to have friends who also have the game to increase your access to them. It's also pay to win, so you can spend your real life money on the game to get those things. Not good value.

Not a game, a cash grab SCAM. Waiting periods for tasks to complete are long, min 2 minutes, max several days. After waiting periods, you often still need additional items to complete tasks, which means a longer, unspecified wait as the item(s) may never arrive on a train. Piggy bank was recently introduced to guarantee that players have to spend real money. Done with this shameless cash grab. Playing 3 days and already spent too much. Don't step into this trap! Devs should be ashamed.

Greedy mechanics, obnoxious mini games... etc. No more grow crops, bake goods and trade for rare stuff and coins, while building a cute town, peaceful gameplay. I don't like fast-paced games, hence why I installed Township to begin with. I don't mind mini games while witing for crops to grow and goods to be ready, but they should be in the same peaceful type as the main game. I've uninstalled.

Downloaded Township after seeing the Ad. This game is nothing like the Ad. It takes too long to acquire buildings, crops take ages to grow. The factory processing is another lengthy wait. The trains & ships take forever to return with much needed supplies. The expansion process is pointless for the small area you are allowed. Most of the time, you're waiting around for things to happen. Don't waste time downloading this game unless you're a zombie with copious amounts of money to waste!!

The game is enjoyable, it has good graphics and offers different types of game within a game. All in all I enjoy it. However recently, I have found that the puzzle games are rigged. Generally some levels are designed to be virtually unbeatable and to succesfully finish it, you would have to spend game cash, which also means actual cash. I understand the business aspect of it, however, this blatant cash grab is just turning me off. Hence I'm starting to slowly lose interest in this game.

I was enjoying this game. Until you have to wait hours for anything to be ready. One item said 24 hours and after the 24 hours it is now 22 hours. It takes to long to grow the crops and to make anything. The awards are very slim picking. I stared playing this game to get gems for another game. Made purchases and made the level I was suppose to get and did not get any awards. This game is very frustrating. It seems to be the way with all games. They just want your money. It's a money grab game!!

Making a game unplayable without money is the main problem with this game. If a person gets the hang of playing, he might even pay one-day. But it's a tough pil to swallow. Also, Advertisement didn't showed the real gameplay, at all. Whatever you do, the process takes 5 to 30 mins. Unless you buy the rare currency in game. Shame. Could've been a very enjoyable game.

This game doesn't know what it wants to be. A management sim or a puzzle game? The games BIGGEST flaw is the growing of wheat, corn, carrots etc or the boxing of products etc. This is a mobile game, nobody is going to wait long periods of time. The puzzle game we've seen time and time again in other games. The only reason it's in the game is because of slow gameplay of the management game. I can't recommend this game at all until then.

I like it. However the adds for Playrix games are super deceiving! They show game play that just DOES NOT EXIST! I like the game but this company is good at ruining a good game. I really miss my zoo shops that I spent time and effort upgrading for them to simply be discontinued. They're now just decorations. That's total BS! Don't spend money on this game. You never know when your efforts will be wasted by the next update. Bring back my zoo shops. My 5 stars is being reduced to 3 stars.

I do enjoy this game. However, i used to play this a while ago I think on another and old device, I had saved my progress AND made sure because I actually spend real money on the game for example, the hover train and the helicopter was something different I can't remember what it was. Anyway, my point.. When I had downloaded the game again, I had lost all my purchases etc. The only thing I had seem to keep was my level and cash. Please help me with this issue developement team! 🙏

Please update the decorations. Nothing seems to match, which makes it hard to organize my town to look like a real place. It would also be great if we could place fences on cement pieces. What happened to the other mini-games, and why have the Golden Pass prizes become so stingy? also the buildings should be able to rotate all the way around. ive been playing for years and ive barely expanded at all becuz everything costs so much. its crazy. I dont wanna delete, read reviews and listen to us!!!

When i first played the game (almost 6 years ago) it was fun. The mini games were achievable. The tasks were reasonable. It rated 5 stars. Now the developers have made all tasks harder, unachievable unless you have a lot of ingame cash. Before you can get a reasonable amount of ingame cash. But then the developers made that harder to do. Now the only way to finish tasks or events is to buy (with real cash) ingame cash. Basically all the fun has been taken out.

well, it started off promising. Good way to kill boredom, no ads, and a bit of variety in there. Unfortunately, it very quickly becomes a greedy, disgusting money grabbing game. The puzzles from lvl 200ish onwards, for the most part are all designed to make you fail so you purchase in-game currency to use extra moves and finish them. One level that sticks out is 279; it is literally impossible with breaking out your credit card. I'll be avoiding this studio from now on. Disgusting.

Since the latest update I have been unable to play this game both on my PC and Android phone. On the PC it opens then straight away closes most times. Occasionally it opens for a few minutes, but ultimately closes again. On the Adroid I can't even open the app. I also hate that there is no longer a short cut to the airport. I tend to forget to go there more than I remember. The previous update you changed tge Regatta and now there doesn't seem to be a way to invite people to join the team. ????

Not as advertised... As many players found out, the game advertised (where you control the character, gather products to sell and develop your business) is just a mini game that very rarely shows up. This game is entirely different and while not the worst, it is a total disappointment when you expect to play the game you saw in the ad.

This is the game about building your farm! Nobody wants to play thousands of puzzles. You have 4 PUZZLE GAMES already and you add add this "very interesting minigame" to your best game. Everyone will be happy if you just remove this puzzle forever instead of answering "Your feedback is important for us. Have a good day". This is a really good game, one of the best on mobile in my opinion. It is very good that there is no add... For now. But this puzzle ruined everything. And it is sad :(

Downed from 5 star to 3. Loved this game for over a year and got quite far. There are zero annoying ads. I lowered my review because of all the update changes. The droppy game keeps putting me on super hard levels with very few easy medium and hard. You have to pass the levels to open rewards, which was changed some time ago. I now refuse to put any more money into a game designed to get harder beyond hard. Keep it a little longer, but I find I've lost interest in this app. 👎

I have been playing for a few months now. Spent about $5 thus far. This game is fun, addictive, challenging, w/ good soundtrack and nice mini games (though wish there were other minigames). However, by the time you reach about lvl 20, things start to get REALLY difficult. A lot of the game comes down to adquiring 'marerials'. But these are EXTREMELY hard to get w/o spending much real $. Question is: is it w/ spending the equiv. of a monthly subscription for streaming service? I don't think so.

The game, particularly the mini games, soft lock you from progressing in order to get you to use microtransactions. The game is like every other game like it. It has nothing novel to offer that sets it apart from other games. It's just another glorified get-rich-quick scheme. That said, after scanning the installation it comes up with a keystroke logger which only appears listed when the game is installed, meaning the installation is infected with a malicious worm.

The farming game is good, but the puzzle game is completely unnecessary. I wish it didn’t exist because it feels out of place. I bought the monthly pass, but progress relies on the puzzle game, which is honestly frustrating. If you're marketing this as a farming game, there’s no reason to include unnecessary mechanics. The progress of the pass should come from the base game, not the puzzle game. I’m never buying anything from this game again because it’s clear the devs are just being greedy.

Really bad interface, it's very hard to select what you want to interact with and not accidentally press something else. You can even accidently use premium items because there's no warning and it's hard to tell what you're selecting(ive wasted a lot of gems and the most valuable item a skip coupon this way). Also there's too many ads its hard to focus on the game. otherwise pretty fun and addictive and nice art style.

I used to love the game but now all the prices have gone up, the games are harder, it's next to impossible to get all the cards for the events unless you spend real money...trying to find something similar

The game is good. There is a new ingame, where it is faulty. Can't go forward, no backwards. The robot helper is not working, but now the support doesn't know his own game either. So annoyed. And again, other issues come. Support is useless and waste off money if the event finishes without the prizes that you have already reached. If they can't solve your problem, they ban your messages.

This game is boring in the first few levels, then when your piggy bank is full, they charge you real money to open it. Now the game wants me to update the game but won't let me play because of storage space on my tablet, I deleted 2 apps and still I can't play now. All it does is says to down load and freezes. I liked the game, but it's not worth the aggravation, of closing all the time. I do like how you can feed animals, and farming.

They will allow you to buy things and then take it away, and never make it right.Their customer service just makes excuses why they get to keep your money while not providing what you paid for. scam! scam! scam! dont do it!!! Shame I used to love this game!

I gave it 5 stars because I truly love it.I have noticed that some features I enjoyed in the past are no longer available, such as merging, the mining competition to rank 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and the event calendar. The energy bar is quite small, especially since we now spend more energy to clear fewer than three obstacles. The regatta coins we earn for buying items are also very limited; I wish it were more of them. I feel it's not worth it to fill zoo orders because the XP and coins are way smaller

I would give this a zero stars! It was great to begin with, the tasks were challenging and exciting. Playrix have removed more and more rewards and this new fashion pass is ridiculous. Before you got to see how many tasks to achieve to reach the next level. They have now also changed the boosters and they are even worse! Each time you play a game, you only get given ONE KEY! So they've made it 10 times harder and force you to buy more purchases! I have seen many reviews at one stars recently.

This game used to be so much fun, but it's now dull, repetitive, and you are forced to spend money to achieve anything at all in their minigames Many popular minigames haven't been seen in a long time, and it seems like playrix are trying to suck their players dry. I've stopped regularly logging in now, just maybe once a month, and then find out that it's rev and ride, or the gumball game, yet again.

I'll be honest, I love the game, but in the match 3 minigame, one of the tutorial levels further in where it introduces the grass, it is legitimately unplayable. When it asks you to press the "rocket" in the specific place, it's never there and I cannot carry on with the level, nor the overall game, as it doesn't let me go back to my town. I'll now have to reinstall this game and waste more of my time getting everything back with unnecessarily long wait times for everything.

I started playing very recently. Initially it felt good but later it makes you spend money for the silly items which are basically critical in expanding, building the town, or clearing the level(something similar to candy crush). Not at all similar to how the advertisement appears. Don't fall for it just like how I did😏. Cannot really come to give more than 1 star!

This game is very addictive game it's really too nice. but when you come to the animations of the factories it would be nice instead of boxes there would be something different in each of the factories. if that was there it would be a best game for me. Edit: I regret writing this review. I am really sad seeing how this game has evolved over the years. It was a fun city building game until the devs decided to get a bunch more (fake) players using 100% clickbaity ads. Absolutely trash.

4/5 stars! Township is a fun game where you build and manage your own town! However, I'd love to see a small fix: even though I've opted for confirmation when spending T-cash, it doesn't apply when adding moves to "Play On" after failing a level. This has led to accidental purchases a few times, which is frustrating. Hope you guys can fix this soon!

puzzle games are more than frustrating. I don't think it's ok to HAVE to repeat the same level so many times just because it's extra hard, using those boosters makes it even more frustrating because they are intentionally located in impossible places just so you can't use them. Not all of the boosters and combos detonate in the way the player intended, they sometimes move in a different way. Fix and rebalance the levels, it's not fun to be stuck and have to pay in game money just to pass the lvl

The game is very addictive. But I've had to give it a 1 * because it's so hard to build the population when you don't get the correct materials. You have green money in a piggy bank that you CAN NOT use unless you buy it with real money. No One can afford to keep buying the green money. I have lots of property that I can't build as I hardly get any building materials on the trains 😥

I like the farming because you can grow it at your own pace, but the games inside (matching tiles, matching patch etc) are very hard to win up to impossible. What is supposed to be relaxing, has become very stressful. It is not what i expect of a game that i play when i try to relax from day to day tasks. You can only win after you spent 15 lives. So, I will be looking f something relaxing, not this unpartial and rigged game.

I don't like the fact that the mini games on here are so hard. You have a different one like the colour block then the renovating but they don't start again they carry on from a different game?! Don't give you a chance anymore. And I refuse to spend money all the time for the dollars in the game to carry on and get done over. Regatta tasks are not fair as they always offer low points in my team. Don't know what has happened to this game.

It is a very fun game. I would rate it 5 out 5, except for the fact that special events always center around one game. Before, 4 or 5 games would alternate, but now, it is always the same one, and it always leads to a level that is practically unfeasable. The goal is obviously to make you spend township dollars, and real money to replenish them. For that reason, I don't take part in the special event. Even if you pay 6.99 for seasonal events, in order to progress it is back to the game.

I wanted to love the game but I don't. The ad is misleading, it's not a farming game it's a town building one. Maybe a good one but that's not what I was looking for. really enjoying game so far. Love this game. - There is constant updates to keep the game well maintained and bug free, which means it runs very well 99% of the time. - They also constantly keeping their gameplay engaging with new regattas and events; the mini games are always different, which adds to the variety. - So much content! so far the game feels good and fun. I appreciate no ads. It's a classic bait and hook game. Very slow game play. You won't be able to do much in this game unless you purchase some premium currency.
